 if(action==='Walk')dy-=Math.abs(Math.sin(now*.024))*2.4*(engine.h||600)/600;
 if(action==='Attack'){
   const t=Math.min(1,elapsed/460);
   const advance=Math.sin(t*Math.PI)*9*(engine.h||600)/600;
   dx+=Math.sign(towardX)*advance;
   dy-=Math.sin(t*Math.PI)*3;
 }
 if(action==='Hurt')dx+=Math.sin(now*.08)*2.6;
 ctx.save();
 ctx.globalAlpha=actor.inv>0&&Math.floor(now/80)%2===0?.68:1;
 ctx.translate(actor.x+dx,actor.y+dy+bob);
 if(mirror)ctx.scale(-1,1);
 if(action==='Idle')ctx.rotate(Math.sin(now*.006)*.025);
 ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
 ctx.drawImage(img,crop.x,crop.y,crop.w,crop.h,-width/2,-height*.64,width,height);
 ctx.restore();
 shinyActualFrames[action]++;
 engine.v3559ShinyLast={id:engine.v3559CurrentId,side:engine.v3559EnemyFlag?'enemy':'ally',action,frame:index,frameCount:frames,durationMs:frameDuration,now};
 return index;
}
BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon=function(actor,id,isEnemy,now){
 const mon=isEnemy?foe():current(),entry=this.assets?.get(id);
 if(!mon?.shiny || !entry || !actor || !this.ctx)return shinyPreviousDrawMon.call(this,actor,id,isEnemy,now);
 const imgs=shinyProtectedImages(id);
 if(!imgs?.Idle?.complete || !imgs.Idle.naturalHeight)return shinyPreviousDrawMon.call(this,actor,id,isEnemy,now);
 const action=shinySelectAction(actor,this,isEnemy,id);
 const img=(imgs[action]?.complete&&imgs[action]?.naturalHeight)?imgs[action]:imgs.Idle;
 const ctx=this.ctx;
 this.v3559CurrentId=id;this.v3559EnemyFlag=isEnemy;
 shinyBlitFrame(ctx,img,action,actor,isEnemy?this.player:this.enemy,this,now);
 shinyProtectedFrames++;
 // Proteção e flash mantidos sem alterar a animação original do sprite.
 if(actor.guard>0){
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.55;ctx.strokeStyle='#a5f7ff';ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(actor.x,actor.y-(this.h||600)*.05,(this.h||600)*.052,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
 }
 // Estrelas APENAS por 2,2 segundos após entrada/switch, nunca num loop infinito.
 if(battle?.active){
    const idField=isEnemy?'v3559EnemyIdentity':'v3559PlayerIdentity';
    const untilField=isEnemy?'v3559EnemyEntryUntil':'v3559PlayerEntryUntil';
    if(battle[idField]!==mon){battle[idField]=mon;battle[untilField]=now+2200;}
    const rem=Math.max(0,(battle[untilField]||0)-now);
    if(rem>0){
      const progress=1-rem/2200,fade=Math.min(1,rem/340)*Math.min(1,(progress+.03)*6);
      const sc=(this.h||500)/500, spread=(14+10*Math.sin(progress*Math.PI))*sc;
      const cx=actor.x,cy=actor.y-(this.h||500)*.105;
      for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
        const a=i*Math.PI*2/7+now*.003;
        shinyVectorStar(ctx,cx+Math.cos(a)*spread,cy+Math.sin(a)*spread*.84,(i%3===0?5:3.3)*sc,fade*(.56+(i%2)*.12),a+now*.003);
      }
      shinyProtectedStars++;
    }
 }
 return true;
};
function shinyProtectedPortraits(){
 document.querySelectorAll('.moncard').forEach((card,i)=>{
   const mon=(save?.team||[])[i],pic=card.querySelector('.spritewrap img.sprite');
   const uri=mon?.shiny?SHINY_PROTEGIDO_SPRITES[mon.id]?.Portrait:null;
   if(pic&&uri && pic.dataset.v3559Portrait!=='yes'){

   }

}

/* V35.58: inteligencia para lutadores e impactos fisicos, sem editar sprites/efeitos de golpes aprovados */
(function(){
 const previousUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
 BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
   const res=previousUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
   if(!battle?.active||battle.paused||!this.enemy||!this.player)return res;
   const mon=foe(),inf=D[mon?.id];
   if(!inf)return res;
   const fighting=(inf.type==='fighting'||inf.type2==='fighting');
   // Adversarios lutadores aproximam-se para poder acertar, sem teleporte.
   if(fighting){
     const dx=this.player.x-this.enemy.x,dy=this.player.y-this.enemy.y;
     const dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,ideal=Math.max(56,this.h*.18);
     if(dist>ideal+3){
       const advance=Math.min(dist-ideal,(this.h*.25)*Math.min(dt,.04));
       this.enemy.x+=dx/dist*advance;
       this.enemy.y+=dy/dist*advance;
       if(typeof this.collideRocks==='function')this.collideRocks(this.enemy);
       if(typeof this.bounds==='function')this.bounds(this.enemy);
     }
   }
   return res;
 };
 const previousDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
 BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
   const result=previousDraw.call(this,now);
   if(!battle?.active||!this.ctx)return result;
   const ctx=this.ctx, effects=this.v359Attacks||[];
   const recent=effects.findLast?.(fx=>fx&&fx.kind==='contact'&&fx.move?.type==='fighting'&&now>=fx.at&&now<fx.at+fx.duration)
     || [...effects].reverse().find(fx=>fx&&fx.kind==='contact'&&fx.move?.type==='fighting'&&now>=fx.at&&now<fx.at+fx.duration);
   if(!recent)return result;
   const progress=(now-recent.at)/Math.max(1,recent.duration);
   if(progress<.25||progress>.76)return result;
   const fade=Math.max(0,Math.sin(Math.PI*(progress-.25)/.51));
   const tx=recent.to?.[0]||this.enemy.x,ty=recent.to?.[1]||this.enemy.y;
   ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=fade*.76;ctx.translate(tx,ty);
   for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
     const ang=i*Math.PI/3+now*.002,rad=(9+fade*16)*(this.h/560);
     ctx.strokeStyle=i%2?'#ffe5b9':'#e49e78';ctx.lineWidth=(i%2?1.8:2.4)*(this.h/560);
     ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(ang)*rad*.55,Math.sin(ang)*rad*.55);
     ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(ang)*rad,Math.sin(ang)*rad);ctx.stroke();
   }
   ctx.restore();
   return result;
 };
})();

   }

   for(const el of badges.slice(1))el.remove();
   if(badges[0]){badges[0].textContent=V;badges[0].style.cssText='font-size:12px;color:#b3fff2;padding:3px 8px;margin-left:8px;border:1px solid #77c4bc;border-radius:8px;display:inline-block;';}

/* V35.60 — IA: combate justo, perseguicao fisica, esquivas com cooldown, variacao por chefe. */
(function(){
 const oldUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
 let decisions=0,dodges=0,retreats=0;
 BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
   const alive=!!battle?.active&&!battle.paused;
   const foeBefore=alive?foe():null;
   const previousEnemy=alive&&this.enemy?{x:this.enemy.x,y:this.enemy.y}:null;
   const result=oldUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
   if(!alive||!battle?.active||!foeBefore||!this.enemy||!this.player)return result;
   const stats=D[foe()?.id];if(!stats)return result;
   const boss=(!battle.wild)&&(battle.v32Mode==='tower'&&battle.v32Floor%5===0 || /chefe|campe[aã]o|l[ií]der|blue|rival/i.test(battle.label||''));
   const isFighter=stats.type==='fighting'||stats.type2==='fighting';
   const dist=Math.hypot(this.enemy.x-this.player.x,this.enemy.y-this.player.y)||1;
   // Permite decisoes mais frequentes sem zerar o cooldown a cada quadro.
   if(Number.isFinite(this.enemyAttackCD)&&this.enemyAttackCD>0){
      const cap=boss?1.48:(battle.wild?2.10:1.78);
      this.enemyAttackCD=Math.min(cap,this.enemyAttackCD);
   }
   if(!this.v3560AiTick||now>=this.v3560AiTick){
      this.v3560AiTick=now+(boss?410:620);decisions++;
      const hp=(foe()?.hp||0)/Math.max(1,foe()?.maxHp||1);
      if(!isFighter && hp<.25 && dist<this.h*.26 && !this.telegraph){
        const dx=(this.enemy.x-this.player.x)/dist,dy=(this.enemy.y-this.player.y)/dist;
        this.enemy.x+=dx*this.h*.042;this.enemy.y+=dy*this.h*.042;
        this.collideRocks(this.enemy);this.bounds(this.enemy);retreats++;
      }
      // Desvio legivel e limitado; o inimigo nao ganha invulnerabilidade eterna.
      const projectile=(this.projectiles||[]).find(p=>p.from==='player'&&p.life>.1 && Math.hypot(p.x-this.enemy.x,p.y-this.enemy.y)<this.h*.20);
      if(projectile && (!this.v3560LastDodge || now-this.v3560LastDodge>(boss?2600:3700)) && this.enemy.inv<=0 && Math.random()<(boss?.48:.25)){
        const dx=projectile.vx,dy=projectile.vy,ll=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
        const side=(Math.floor(now/700)%2)?1:-1;
        this.enemy.x+=(-dy/ll)*this.h*.067*side;this.enemy.y+=(dx/ll)*this.h*.067*side;
        this.bounds(this.enemy);this.collideRocks(this.enemy);
        this.v3560LastDodge=now;dodges++;this.particlesAt(this.enemy.x,this.enemy.y,'#adddea',5,42);
      }
   }
   return result;
 };
 window.PokemonTorreV3560AIDiagnostics=()=>({decisions,dodges,retreats,cooldown:engine?.enemyAttackCD,enemy:foe()?.id});
})();

/* V35.60 — contato corporal: recuo temporario e poeira de impacto sem alterar efeitos nomeados. */
(function(){
 const oldHit=BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget;
 const oldDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
 let impacts=0;
 BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget=function(who,type,power){
   const before=who==='enemy'?foe()?.hp:current()?.hp;
   const result=oldHit.call(this,who,type,power);
   const after=who==='enemy'?foe()?.hp:current()?.hp;
   if(before!=null&&after!=null&&before>after && ['normal','fighting'].includes(type)){
      const target=who==='enemy'?this.enemy:this.player;
      this.v3560Contact||(this.v3560Contact=[]);
      this.v3560Contact.push({x:target.x,y:target.y-this.h*.12,at:performance.now(),duration:250});
      this.v3560Contact=this.v3560Contact.slice(-12);
      if(target){target.flash=Math.max(target.flash||0,.13);}
      impacts++;
   }
   return result;
 };
 BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
   const result=oldDraw.call(this,now);
   if(!battle?.active||!this.ctx)return result;
   const c=this.ctx;
   this.v3560Contact=(this.v3560Contact||[]).filter(v=>now-v.at<v.duration);
   c.save();
   for(const fx of this.v3560Contact){
     const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(now-fx.at)/fx.duration)),a=(1-t)*.75;
     c.globalAlpha=a;c.lineWidth=1.9;
     for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
       const ang=i*Math.PI*2/5+fx.at*.001,rad=(9+t*15)*(this.h/560);
       c.strokeStyle=i%2?'#fff0c7':'#ceac85';c.beginPath();
       c.moveTo(fx.x+Math.cos(ang)*rad*.65,fx.y+Math.sin(ang)*rad*.48);
       c.lineTo(fx.x+Math.cos(ang)*rad,fx.y+Math.sin(ang)*rad*.75);c.stroke();
     }
   }
   c.restore();return result;
 };
 window.PokemonTorreV3560ContactDiagnostics=()=>({impacts,active:engine?.v3560Contact?.length||0});
})();

/* V35.60 — terreno interativo: clima visivel e efeitos de movimento/calor graduais. */
(function(){
 const oldUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update,oldDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
 let heatTicks=0,iceSlips=0;
 function weather(){return String(battle?.v32Weather||'clear').toLowerCase();}
 function isVolcano(){return weather()==='volcano'||(save.gym===6 && /vulc[aã]o|blaine/i.test((GYMS[6]?.name||'')+' '+(battle?.label||'')));}
 BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
   const active=!!battle?.active&&!battle.paused,py=active?this.player?.y:0,px=active?this.player?.x:0;
   const result=oldUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
   if(!active||!battle?.active)return result;
   const state=weather();
   if(state==='snow'||state==='hail'){
      // Solo gelado: velocidade reduzida cerca de 8%, sem mexer na esquiva.
      const changed=Math.hypot(this.player.x-px,this.player.y-py);
      if(changed>0.1){this.player.x=px+(this.player.x-px)*.92;this.player.y=py+(this.player.y-py)*.92;iceSlips++;}
   }
   if(isVolcano() && battle.v32Mode!=='lab'){
      if(!this.v3560HeatNext)this.v3560HeatNext=now+6000;
      if(now>=this.v3560HeatNext){this.v3560HeatNext=now+6000;heatTicks++;
        const p=current(),e=foe();
        for(const m of [p,e]){if(!m||m.hp<=1)continue;const d=D[m.id];if(d?.type==='fire'||d?.type2==='fire')continue;
          m.hp=Math.max(1,m.hp-Math.max(1,Math.floor(m.maxHp*.012)));
        }
        this.particlesAt(this.w*.5,this.h*.72,'#ffae58',12,38);
        log('🔥 Calor da lava: pequena perda de PV para tipos sem resistência.');
      }
   }else this.v3560HeatNext=0;
   return result;
 };
 BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
   const result=oldDraw.call(this,now);if(!battle?.active||!this.ctx)return result;
   const st=weather(),c=this.ctx,w=this.w,h=this.h;
   if(st==='clear')return result;
   c.save();
   // Particulas animadas discretas, criadas em Canvas (sem PNG estatico).
   if(st==='rain'||st==='storm'){
     c.lineWidth=1;c.strokeStyle='rgba(185,223,250,.23)';
     for(let i=0;i<16;i++){const x=((i*97+now*.15)%(w+40))-20,y=((i*71+now*.31)%(h*.63))+h*.28;
       c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,y);c.lineTo(x-3,y+12);c.stroke();}
   }else if(st==='snow'||st==='hail'){
     c.fillStyle='rgba(232,248,255,.47)';for(let i=0;i<17;i++){const x=(i*73+now*.015*(1+i%3))%w,y=(i*43+now*.023)%h;c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,1.2+(i%2),0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();}
   }else if(isVolcano()){
     c.fillStyle='rgba(255,122,43,.27)';for(let i=0;i<9;i++){const x=(i*101+now*.004)%w,y=h*.9-(i*32+now*.013)%(h*.39);c.fillRect(x,y,2,3);}
   }
   c.restore();return result;
 };
 window.PokemonTorreV3560ArenaDiagnostics=()=>({weather:weather(),volcano:isVolcano(),heatTicks,iceSlips,breakableRocks:engine?.rocks?.filter(r=>r.hp>0).length||0});

 }

 }
 // Alcance verdadeiro apenas para movimentos básicos de contato. Não toca em golpes assinados.
 function isBasicContact(move){const n=String(move?.name||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase();return /^(investida|arranhao|tackle|scratch)$/.test(n);}
 BattleEngine.prototype.useMove=function(i){

     if(dist>reach){info.contactMisses++;note(this,this.player,'APROXIME-SE','#ffdcae');return false;}

   const result=earlierHit.call(this,side,type,power);

   if(before>after&&source&&target&&['normal','fighting'].includes(type)){

 BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
   const active=!!battle?.active&&!battle.paused;

   const result=earlierUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
   if(!active||!battle?.active||!this.player||!this.enemy)return result;
   const sideP=conditionList(this,'player'),sideE=conditionList(this,'enemy');
   const pm=motilityFactor(this,'player'),em=motilityFactor(this,'enemy');
   if(pm<1){this.player.x=pre.pX+(this.player.x-pre.pX)*pm;this.player.y=pre.pY+(this.player.y-pre.pY)*pm;this.bounds(this.player);}
   if(em<1){this.enemy.x=pre.eX+(this.enemy.x-pre.eX)*em;this.enemy.y=pre.eY+(this.enemy.y-pre.eY)*em;this.bounds(this.enemy);}
   if(sideE.includes('sleep')||sideE.includes('freeze')){
     // O turno de preparação não pode chegar a 0 enquanto dorme.
     this.enemyAttackCD=Math.max(.36,this.enemyAttackCD||0);
     if(this.telegraph?.from==='enemy')this.telegraph=null;
   }
   if(sideE.includes('paralysis')&& now>(this.v3562ParaEnemy||0)){
     this.v3562ParaEnemy=now+1800;
     if(Math.random()<.22){this.enemyAttackCD=Math.max(.55,this.enemyAttackCD||0);info.paralysisDelays++;note(this,this.enemy,'PARALISADO','#ffeb91');}
   }
   // Não duplicar veneno, queimadura ou sementes: já possuem tick próprio na base.
   const tile=terrain();this.v3562Terrain=tile;
   if(!this.v3562GroundTick)this.v3562GroundTick=now+3500;
   if(now>=this.v3562GroundTick){
     this.v3562GroundTick=now+3500;info.ticks++;
     if(tile==='grass'){
       for(const m of [current(),foe()])if(m?.hp>0&&m.hp<m.maxHp && typeOf(m)==='grass')m.hp=Math.min(m.maxHp,m.hp+Math.max(1,Math.round(m.maxHp*.009)));
     }
     if(tile==='electric'){
       for(const [side,m,a] of [['player',current(),this.player],['enemy',foe(),this.enemy]]){
         const st=conditionList(this,side);if(typeOf(m)==='electric'&&st.includes('paralysis')){

         }

   }
   return result;
 };
 BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
   const res=earlierDraw.call(this,now);if(!battle?.active||!this.ctx)return res;
   const c=this.ctx,w=this.w,h=this.h,t=this.v3562Terrain||terrain();

     const x=(.13+i*.104)*w, y=(.78+Math.sin(i*3.4)*.13)*h,phase=now*.0008+i*1.9;
     if(t==='grass'){

     }else if(t==='water'){
       c.strokeStyle='rgba(156,225,248,.24)';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(x,y,8+Math.sin(phase)*2,3.8,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();
     }else if(t==='electric'){
       c.strokeStyle='rgba(250,227,116,.24)';const s=Math.sin(phase)*3;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x-4,y-2);c.lineTo(x+s,y+1);c.lineTo(x+4,y-2);c.stroke();
     }else if(t==='rock'){
       c.strokeStyle='rgba(185,151,114,.19)';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x-6,y);c.lineTo(x-2,y-3);c.lineTo(x+2,y+1);c.lineTo(x+6,y-2);c.stroke();
     }else if(t==='ghost'){
       c.fillStyle='rgba(149,125,202,.10)';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(x+Math.cos(phase)*3,y-8,9,3,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
     }
   }
   c.restore();return res;
 };

})();

/* V35.62: dois golpes iniciais de Planta e ataques genéricos inimigos em Canvas 2D. */
(function(){
 'use strict';
 const oldUse=BattleEngine.prototype.useMove;
 const oldUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
 const oldDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;

 const norm=s=>String(s||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
 const cap=(x,a,b)=>Math.min(b,Math.max(a,x));
 let vines=0,drains=0,enemyFrames=0,healedTotal=0;
 function curve(c,x,y,tx,ty,shift,phase){
   const dx=tx-x,dy=ty-y,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,nx=-dy/len,ny=dx/len;
   c.beginPath();for(let j=0;j<=14;j++){
      const q=j/14,wiggle=Math.sin(q*9.4+phase)*(4+shift)*Math.sin(Math.PI*q),off=(shift+wiggle);
      const px=x+dx*q+nx*off,py=y+dy*q+ny*off*.55;
      if(j===0)c.moveTo(px,py);else c.lineTo(px,py);
   }
 }
 BattleEngine.prototype.useMove=function(i){
   const s=battle?.active&&current()?skillSet(current())?.[i]:null,key=norm(s?.name);
   if(!s||!['chicotedevinha','vinewhip','absorver','absorb'].includes(key))return oldUse.call(this,i);
   const now=performance.now();if(battle.paused||current().hp<=0||(cooldowns[i]||0)>now||battle.energy<(s.cost||0))return false;
   battle.energy-=(s.cost||0);cooldowns[i]=now+(s.cd||1750);
   this.attackActs.player=this.time+.35;
   const kind=['chicotedevinha','vinewhip'].includes(key)?'vine':'drain';
   const fx={kind,at:now,hit:now+(kind==='vine'?230:290),end:now+(kind==='vine'?640:950),power:s.power,done:false,healed:false,from:{x:this.player.x,y:this.player.y-this.h*.10},to:{x:this.enemy.x,y:this.enemy.y-this.h*.11},target:foe()};
   (this.v3562PlantFx||(this.v3562PlantFx=[])).push(fx);
   if(kind==='vine')vines++;else drains++;
   this.particlesAt(this.player.x,this.player.y-this.h*.11,'#b9ff92',8,42);
   log(D[current().id].name+' usou '+s.name+'!');playSound('move');return true;
 };
 BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
   const r=oldUpdate.call(this,dt,now),list=this.v3562PlantFx||[];
   if(!battle?.active){list.length=0;return r;}
   for(let i=list.length-1;i>=0;i--){
     const fx=list[i];
     if(!fx.done&&now>=fx.hit){
       const before=fx.target?.hp??0;
       if(foe()===fx.target)this.hitTarget('enemy','grass',fx.power);
       const loss=Math.max(0,before-(fx.target?.hp??before));fx.loss=loss;
       fx.done=true;
       if(fx.kind==='drain'){
         const own=current();const hp=own?Math.min(own.maxHp-own.hp,Math.ceil(loss*.5)):0;
         fx.healAmount=Math.max(0,hp);fx.healTime=now+190;
       }
       if(fx.kind==='vine')this.particlesAt(fx.to.x,fx.to.y,'#b8f8a4',10,52);
     }
     if(fx.kind==='drain'&&fx.done&&!fx.healed&&now>=(fx.healTime||Infinity)){
       fx.healed=true;
       if(fx.healAmount&&current()){current().hp=Math.min(current().maxHp,current().hp+fx.healAmount);healedTotal+=fx.healAmount;
         this.particlesAt(this.player.x,this.player.y-this.h*.1,'#c8ff8c',13,52);
         log(D[current().id].name+' absorveu '+fx.healAmount+' PV!');}
     }
     if(now>fx.end)list.splice(i,1);
   }
   return r;
 };
 // Projéteis inimigos usam traços vetoriais e formas sem texturas quadradas.
 BattleEngine.prototype.drawProjectile=function(p){
   if(p?.from!=='enemy')return oldProjectile.call(this,p);
   const c=this.ctx,type=p.type||'normal',r=Math.max(5,p.r||5),x=p.x,y=p.y,ang=Math.atan2(p.vy||0,p.vx||1);
   const pts=p.tail?.length?p.tail:[{x:x-(p.vx||0)*.03,y:y-(p.vy||0)*.03},{x,y}];
   c.save();c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';
   const path=(color,w,a)=>{c.globalAlpha=a;c.strokeStyle=color;c.lineWidth=w;c.beginPath();pts.forEach((pt,i)=>i?c.lineTo(pt.x,pt.y):c.moveTo(pt.x,pt.y));c.stroke();};
   if(type==='electric'){
     const a=pts[0];c.strokeStyle='#ffe87c';c.lineWidth=2.8;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a.x,a.y);const n=6;
     for(let i=1;i<n;i++){const t=i/n;c.lineTo(a.x+(x-a.x)*t+(i%2?4:-4),a.y+(y-a.y)*t+(i%2?-3:3));}c.lineTo(x,y);c.stroke();
     path('#fffad0',.9,.90);
   }else if(type==='grass'){
     path('#428c50',4,.70);path('#befa94',1.4,.84);
   }else if(type==='water'){
     path('#5bc4ea',4.5,.72);path('#d0f8ff',1.6,.9);
   }else if(type==='fire'){
     path('#e97942',5,.55);path('#ffe8a4',1.5,.88);
   }else{path(TYPE_COLOR[type]||'#abd3db',3.5,.65);path('#f2f6fc',1.2,.65);}
   c.translate(x,y);c.rotate(ang);c.globalAlpha=.95;
   if(type==='grass'){

     c.strokeStyle='#ebffd4';c.lineWidth=1.1;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r,0);c.lineTo(r,0);c.stroke();
   }else if(type==='fire'){
     c.fillStyle='#ffc57d';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r,0);c.quadraticCurveTo(0,-r*1.45,r*.8,0);c.quadraticCurveTo(0,r*1.12,-r,0);c.fill();
     c.fillStyle='#f66b37';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(-r*.08,r*.14,r*.44,r*.5,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
   }else if(type==='water'){
     c.fillStyle='#9cecff';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r*.55,0);c.quadraticCurveTo(0,-r*1.2,r*.82,0);c.quadraticCurveTo(0,r,-r*.55,0);c.fill();
   }else if(type==='electric'){
     c.strokeStyle='#fff3ae';c.lineWidth=2.5;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r,-r*.18);c.lineTo(-r*.08,-r*.5);c.lineTo(-r*.22,r*.08);c.lineTo(r*.3,-r*.05);c.lineTo(0,r*.75);c.lineTo(r,0);c.stroke();
   }else{
     c.fillStyle=TYPE_COLOR[type]||'#d3e9ee';c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r*.80,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
     c.strokeStyle='#fff8';c.lineWidth=1.2;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r*.46,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();
   }

 };
 BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
   const ret=oldDraw.call(this,now),list=this.v3562PlantFx||[];if(!battle?.active||!list.length||!this.ctx)return ret;
   const c=this.ctx;

   for(const fx of list){
     const tt=cap((now-fx.at)/Math.max(1,fx.end-fx.at),0,1);
     const sx=fx.from.x,sy=fx.from.y,tx=fx.to.x,ty=fx.to.y;
     if(fx.kind==='vine'){
       const growth=cap((now-fx.at)/(fx.hit-fx.at),0,1), retract=cap((now-fx.hit)/(fx.end-fx.hit),0,1);
       const progress=Math.max(0,growth*(1-retract*.97));
       const ex=sx+(tx-sx)*progress,ey=sy+(ty-sy)*progress;
       for(const s of [-1,1]){
         c.globalAlpha=.92*(1-retract*.68);c.strokeStyle='#307b38';c.lineWidth=5.5;c.beginPath();curve(c,sx,sy,ex,ey,s*4,now*.016+s);c.stroke();
         c.strokeStyle='#a4f583';c.lineWidth=2;c.beginPath();curve(c,sx,sy,ex,ey,s*4,now*.016+s);c.stroke();
       }
       if(!fx.done){c.fillStyle='#e0ffb6';c.globalAlpha=.70;c.beginPath();c.arc(ex,ey,3.4,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();}
     }else{
       const start=fx.done?fx.hit:fx.at, travel=cap((now-start)/(fx.end-start),0,1);
       const vx=fx.done?tx:sx,vy=fx.done?ty:sy,wx=fx.done?sx:tx,wy=fx.done?sy:ty;
       c.globalAlpha=.65*(1-tt*.42);c.strokeStyle='#7bcf77';c.lineWidth=2.4;c.beginPath();curve(c,tx,ty,sx,sy,0,now*.01);c.stroke();
       for(let k=0;k<9;k++){
         const t=cap(travel+(k-4)*.075,0,1),xx=vx+(wx-vx)*t,yy=vy+(wy-vy)*t+Math.sin(k*1.2+now*.019)*5;
         c.globalAlpha=.28+.56*(1-t*.35);c.fillStyle=k%2?'#b9ff8e':'#62c369';c.beginPath();c.arc(xx,yy,2.3+(k%3)*.7,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
       }
     }
   }
   c.restore();return ret;
 };
 window.PokemonTorreV3562VisualDiagnostics=()=>({vines,drains,enemyFrames,healedTotal,active:engine?.v3562PlantFx?.map(x=>x.kind)||[]});
})();

/* V35.63 — IA de chefes por perfil e Clash de contato sem alterar visuais dos golpes aprovados. */
(function(){
 const oldUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update,oldHit=BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget,oldDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
 let phaseEvents=0,clashes=0,brainTicks=0;
 const personas=[['brock','guardiao'],['misty','agil'],['lt. surge','eletrico'],['erika','distancia'],['koga','esquiva'],['sabrina','controle'],['blaine','agressivo'],['giovanni','guardiao'],['blue','adaptativo'],['bruno','agressivo'],['lorelei','distancia'],['agatha','esquiva'],['lance','agil']];
 function bossInfo(){if(!battle?.active||battle.wild)return null;const label=String(battle.label||'').toLowerCase(),gym=String(GYMS[Math.min(save.gym,12)]?.leader||'').toLowerCase();
  const leader=personas.find(([name])=>label.includes(name)||gym.includes(name)&&/l[ií]der|chefe|rival|blue/i.test(label));
  const flag=/chefe|campe[aã]o|l[ií]der|blue|rival|final/i.test(label)||(battle.v32Mode==='tower'&&battle.v32Floor%5===0);
  return flag?{style:leader?.[1]||'adaptativo',label:leader?.[0]||'chefe'}:null;
 }
 function contactClash(engine,side,type){
  if(!['normal','fighting','bug','dark','steel'].includes(type)||!engine.player||!engine.enemy||!battle?.active)return false;
  const dist=Math.hypot(engine.player.x-engine.enemy.x,engine.player.y-engine.enemy.y);
  const both=(engine.attackActs?.player||0)>engine.time&&(engine.attackActs?.enemy||0)>engine.time;
  return both&&dist<Math.max(56,engine.h*.23)&&(performance.now()-(engine.v3563ClashLast||0))>2400;
 }
 BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget=function(side,type,power){
  if(contactClash(this,side,type)){
   const now=performance.now(),rng=Math.random();
   this.v3563ClashLast=now;
   this.v3563Clash={at:now,until:now+420,x:(this.player.x+this.enemy.x)/2,y:(this.player.y+this.enemy.y)/2-this.h*.08};
   clashes++;
   const dx=this.enemy.x-this.player.x,dy=this.enemy.y-this.player.y,l=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
   const shift=Math.min(14,this.h*.026);
   this.enemy.x+=dx/l*shift;this.enemy.y+=dy/l*shift;
   this.player.x-=dx/l*shift*.55;this.player.y-=dy/l*shift*.55;
   this.bounds(this.enemy);this.bounds(this.player);
   this.particlesAt(this.v3563Clash.x,this.v3563Clash.y,'#fff0bc',12,95);
   if(typeof this.v25Popup==='function')this.v25Popup(this.v3563Clash.x,this.v3563Clash.y-this.h*.05,'CLASH!','#ffe1a3');
   power=power*.72; // choque reduz impacto de ambos, não modifica sprite nem catálogo
  }
  return oldHit.call(this,side,type,power);
 };
 BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){

  const b=bossInfo();if(!b)return res;
  const hp=foe()?.hp||0,max=foe()?.maxHp||1,phase=hp/max<=.5?2:1;
  if(this.v3563BossId!==foe()){this.v3563BossId=foe();this.v3563BossPhase=1;this.v3563BrainAt=0;}
  if(phase===2&&this.v3563BossPhase!==2){this.v3563BossPhase=2;phaseEvents++;this.enemy.focus=Math.max(this.enemy.focus||0,.8);if(typeof this.v25Popup==='function')this.v25Popup(this.enemy.x,this.enemy.y-this.h*.24,'FASE 2 · ESTRATÉGIA','#ffe2a2');}
  if(now<(this.v3563BrainAt||0))return res;
  this.v3563BrainAt=now+(phase===2?900:1400);brainTicks++;
  const e=this.enemy,p=this.player,d=Math.hypot(e.x-p.x,e.y-p.y)||1,nx=(e.x-p.x)/d,ny=(e.y-p.y)/d,speed=this.h*(phase===2?.052:.036);
  if(b.style==='guardiao'){

    e.guard=Math.max(e.guard||0,phase===2?.35:.18);
  }else if(b.style==='agil'||b.style==='esquiva'){
    const sg=Math.sin(now*.003+e.x*.02)>0?1:-1;
    e.x+=-ny*speed*sg;e.y+=nx*speed*sg;
  }else if(b.style==='distancia'||b.style==='controle'){
    if(d<this.h*.32){e.x+=nx*speed;e.y+=ny*speed;}else if(d>this.h*.50){e.x-=nx*speed*.55;e.y-=ny*speed*.55;}
  }else if(b.style==='agressivo'){
    if(d>this.h*.16){e.x-=nx*speed*1.30;e.y-=ny*speed*1.30;}
  }else{
    if(d<this.h*.23){e.x+=nx*speed*.72;e.y+=ny*speed*.72;}
    else if(d>this.h*.43){e.x-=nx*speed*.70;e.y-=ny*speed*.70;}

  return res;
 };

  for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const ang=i*Math.PI/5+now*.002,r=8+p*33;c.strokeStyle=i%2?'#fff9df':'#f8b67b';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(Math.cos(ang)*r*.42,Math.sin(ang)*r*.42);c.lineTo(Math.cos(ang)*r,Math.sin(ang)*r);c.stroke();}c.restore();return res;
 };
 window.PokemonTorreV3563BossDiagnostics=()=>({phaseEvents,clashes,brainTicks,activeBoss:bossInfo(),phase:engine?.v3563BossPhase||0});
})();

/* V35.63 — Marcas temporárias no piso; não substitui efeitos originais de golpes. */
(function(){
 const oldHit=BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget,oldDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw,oldEnemy=BattleEngine.prototype.newEnemy;
 let footprints=0,blocked=0;
 const kinds={fire:['#ee8140','scorch'],ground:['#a88a60','crack'],rock:['#aa9f85','chip'],water:['#77cfe3','ripple'],ice:['#caeefa','frost'],grass:['#80c483','leaf'],electric:['#e6d273','spark']};
 BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget=function(side,type,power){
  const enemy=side==='enemy',before=enemy?foe()?.hp:current()?.hp;
  const target=enemy?this.enemy:this.player;
  const result=oldHit.call(this,side,type,power);

  if(before>after&&target){

      this.v3563Marks=this.v3563Marks.slice(-24);footprints++;

 };
 BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){const out=oldDraw.call(this,now);if(!battle?.active||!this.ctx)return out;
  const c=this.ctx,marks=this.v3563Marks||[];c.save();
  for(const m of marks){const p=(now-m.at)/(m.until-m.at);if(p<0||p>1)continue;
    const [col,shape]=kinds[m.type]||['#e2e2e2','chip'];const a=Math.min(.24,(1-p)*.34);
    c.save();c.globalAlpha=a;c.strokeStyle=col;c.fillStyle=col;c.lineWidth=1.8;c.translate(m.x,m.y);c.rotate(m.seed*.08);

      c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-20*s,-3*s);c.lineTo(-6*s,2*s);c.lineTo(3*s,-7*s);c.lineTo(9*s,7*s);c.lineTo(18*s,3*s);c.stroke();
      if(shape==='scorch'){c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,4*s,17*s,5*s,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();}
    }else if(shape==='ripple'||shape==='frost'){
      for(let j=0;j<2;j++){c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,0,(11+j*8)*s,(4+j*3)*s,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();}
    }else if(shape==='leaf'){
      for(let j=0;j<3;j++){c.beginPath();c.ellipse((j-1)*10*s,-(j%2)*3*s,6*s,2.4*s,j*.5,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();}
    }else{for(let j=0;j<4;j++){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(Math.cos(j*1.57)*9*s,Math.sin(j*1.57)*5*s);c.lineTo(Math.cos(j*1.57)*17*s,Math.sin(j*1.57)*9*s);c.stroke();}}
    c.restore();

 window.PokemonTorreV3563MarksDiagnostics=()=>({created:footprints,active:engine?.v3563Marks?.length||0,blocked});

/* V35.63 — Progressão prática de golpes e estado de batalha legível no HUD. */
(function(){
 const oldUse=BattleEngine.prototype.useMove,oldDamage=damage,oldHud=BattleEngine.prototype.updateHud;
 let tracked=0,bonusHits=0,statusUpdates=0;
 function counts(){return save.v3563UseCounts||(save.v3563UseCounts={});}
 function moveMastery(m,s){const uses=counts()[m?.id]?.[s?.name]||0,lv=m?.level||1;
  // Domínio aumenta progressivamente, sem ultrapassar 6% e sem mudar o efeito visual.
  return Math.min(.06,Math.max(0,Math.floor((lv-5)/15))*.01 + Math.floor(uses/20)*.01);
 }
 BattleEngine.prototype.useMove=function(i){
  const m=battle?.active?current():null,s=m&&skillSet(m)?.[i];

    const all=counts(),entry=all[m.id]||(all[m.id]={});entry[s.name]=(entry[s.name]||0)+1;tracked++;

 };

 };

 BattleEngine.prototype.updateHud=function(now){const r=oldHud.call(this,now);
  if(!battle?.active||!document.getElementById('arenaPro')||now<(this.v3563StatusNext||0))return r;

  for(const [who,side] of [['ally','player'],['enemy','enemy']]){

(function(){

/* Melhora generica dos projeteis do adversario, sem substituir efeitos de golpes aprovados. */
(function(){
 'use strict';
 const prev=BattleEngine.prototype.drawProjectile;
 let drawings=0;
 function path(c,ps,color,w,a){if(ps.length<2)return;c.save();c.globalAlpha=a;c.strokeStyle=color;c.lineWidth=w;c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';c.beginPath();ps.forEach((p,i)=>i?c.lineTo(p.x,p.y):c.moveTo(p.x,p.y));c.stroke();c.restore();}
 BattleEngine.prototype.drawProjectile=function(p){
   if(!p||p.from!=='enemy'||!this.ctx)return prev.call(this,p);
   const c=this.ctx,col=(TYPE_COLOR[p.type]||'#d4eaf0');
   const vx=p.vx||0,vy=p.vy||0,r=Math.max(4,Math.min(15,p.r||6));
   const points=(p.tail||[]).map(a=>({x:a.x,y:a.y}));
   if(points.length<2){points.unshift({x:p.x-vx*.016,y:p.y-vy*.016});points.push({x:p.x,y:p.y});}
   // Particulas leves com movimento em vez de uma imagem plana ou um quadrado.
   path(c,points,col,r*.52,.40);
   path(c,points,'rgba(255,255,255,.75)',1.4,.60);
   c.save();c.translate(p.x,p.y);
   c.rotate(Math.atan2(vy,vx));
   const phase=performance.now()*.016+p.x*.01;
   if(p.type==='rock'||p.type==='ground'){
     c.fillStyle='#bca68d';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r*.8,-r*.2);c.lineTo(-r*.22,-r);c.lineTo(r*.8,-r*.4);c.lineTo(r*.64,r*.77);c.lineTo(-r*.56,r*.88);c.closePath();c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#625041';c.lineWidth=1.4;c.stroke();
   }else if(p.type==='electric'){
     c.strokeStyle='#fff5b0';c.lineWidth=2.6;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r,-r*.55);c.lineTo(0,-r*.5);c.lineTo(-r*.1,r*.15);c.lineTo(r*.65,-r*.20);c.lineTo(r*.14,r*.85);c.stroke();
   }else if(p.type==='fire'){
     c.fillStyle='#ff994a';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r*.9,r*.33);c.quadraticCurveTo(-r*.2,-r*1.6,r*.85,-r*.24);c.quadraticCurveTo(r*1.1,r*.6,r*.15,r*.9);c.closePath();c.fill();c.fillStyle='#ffe28d';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,r*.25,r*.35,r*.55,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
   }else if(p.type==='water'){
     c.fillStyle='#73d2ff';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r*.8,0);c.quadraticCurveTo(0,-r*1.5,r*.85,0);c.quadraticCurveTo(0,r*.95,-r*.8,0);c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#e9ffff';c.lineWidth=1.3;c.stroke();
   }else if(p.type==='grass'){
     c.fillStyle='#8ee86c';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,0,r*1.25,r*.52,Math.sin(phase)*.2,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#e8ffb0';c.lineWidth=1.1;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r,0);c.lineTo(r,0);c.stroke();
   }else if(p.type==='poison'){
     c.fillStyle='#9a63c6';c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r*.82,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#e3b7ff';c.lineWidth=1.2;c.stroke();
     for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const a=phase+i*2.1;c.beginPath();c.arc(Math.cos(a)*r*.58,Math.sin(a)*r*.52,r*.24,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();}
   }else if(p.type==='psychic'||p.type==='ghost'){
